column3: NASB has “the LORD” without “of hosts,” following the written Hebrew; the reading tradition adds “of hosts.” “Escaped remnant” is rendered “survivors.”
“Confront it with a shield” is rendered “come before it with a shield,” and “pour out a mound” as “throw up a mound.”
NASB supplies “men” and does not render “corpses.”
“Departed and went and returned” is rendered “departed and returned home.”
NASB does not have “his sons,” which is only in the reading tradition. “Struck down” is rendered “killed.”
